steps.template_en: 'Every bilinear form is symmetric.' WRONG! B:V×V→F is SYMMETRIC if B(v,w)=B(w,v); ALTERNATING if B(v,w)=-B(w,v), B(v,v)=0. Classification depends on field characteristic.
steps.template_zh: '每个双线性型是对称的。'错！对称若B(v,w)=B(w,v)；交错若B(v,w)=-B(w,v), B(v,v)=0。分类依赖于域特征。

steps.template_en: Standard inner product = dot product. In a basis, B(v,w)=vᵀAw. Symmetric ⟺ Aᵀ=A. Alternating ⟺ Aᵀ=-A, diag=0.
steps.template_zh: 标准内积=点积。在基中，B(v,w)=vᵀAw。对称⟺Aᵀ=A。交错⟺Aᵀ=-A，对角=0。

steps.template_en: Over ℝ: SYLVESTER'S LAW OF INERTIA — symmetric bilinear form diagonalizes with p positive, q negative, r zero. Signature (p,q,r) is INVARIANT. Classification of real quadratic forms.
steps.template_zh: 在ℝ上：Sylvester惯性定律——对称双线性型对角化有p正q负r零。符号差(p,q,r)不变量。实二次型分类。

steps.template_en: Applications: (1) Metric tensors in differential geometry. (2) Special relativity: Minkowski metric signature (3,1,0). (3) Symplectic forms in Hamiltonian mechanics.
steps.template_zh: 应用：(1)微分几何度量张量。(2)狭义相对论：Minkowski度量符号差(3,1,0)。(3)哈密顿力学辛型。

steps.template_en: For each bilinear form on ℝ²: (1) vᵀw. (2) v₁w₁-v₂w₂. (3) v₁w₂-v₂w₁. (4) v₁w₁. Classify as symmetric/alternating/neither. Find matrix. Find signature.
steps.template_zh: 对ℝ²上每个双线性型：(1)vᵀw。(2)v₁w₁-v₂w₂。(3)v₁w₂-v₂w₁。(4)v₁w₁。分为对称/交错/都不是。求矩阵和符号差。

steps.template_en: Bilinear forms generalize 'scalar product.' Different geometries: inner product (symmetric positive definite), symplectic (alternating nondegenerate), Minkowski (indefinite symmetric). Each = DIFFERENT geometry.
steps.template_zh: 双线性型推广'标量积'。不同几何：内积(对称正定)、辛型(交错非退化)、Minkowski(不定对称)。每个=不同几何。
